selection_provenance.dataset_title: Data and code from: Unravelling the drivers of island species richness in tropical savannas
selection_provenance.published_information_already_known: the source article reports weak/no direct-isolation effects on richness; this known result is not the target and prevents counting this study as independent Structural confirmation

spatial_unit.coordinate_semantics: decimal-degree murundu centroid coordinates as documented by Dryad README

source_topology.source_set: within the same plot, all murundus with strictly larger Area_Mur_m2 than the focal murundu
source_topology.largest_ties: any focal murundu with no strictly larger source is excluded before response scoring
source_topology.direct_source_isolation: great-circle distance in metres to the nearest strictly larger-area murundu within the same plot
source_topology.graph: complete graph of all murundus in the same plot with great-circle inter-murundu distance as edge weight
source_topology.minimax_bottleneck: minimum over all paths from the focal murundu to any strictly larger-area source of the maximum edge length along the path
source_topology.interpretation: reduction in the hardest movement step provided by intermediate habitat islands; not a dispersal probability

geometry_gate.failure_rule: terminal STOP before response column parsing; do not change source rule, topology metric, thresholds, plot membership, or model

response_gate.transform: within each response-qualified plot, z-standardize log1p(Richness.Trees) using population SD ddof=0
response_gate.missing_values: remain missing and are never converted to zero
response_gate.zero_richness: allowed as observed zero and transformed via log1p
response_gate.failure_rule: terminal STOP with no H1 estimate if fewer than 8 plots pass response completeness/design; do not loosen response-completeness or rank requirements

per_plot_model.family: ordinary least squares on within-plot z(log1p tree richness)
per_plot_model.continuous_predictor_scaling: within each geometry-qualified plot, z-standardize using population SD ddof=0 before interactions
per_plot_model.fit_scope: one independent model per qualified plot

H1_primary.question: Does stepping-stone topology buffer the richness cost of relative source isolation within habitat-island metacommunities?
H1_primary.estimand: equal-weight mean across response-qualified plots of the per-plot direct_x_gain coefficient
H1_primary.success_rule: 95% whole-plot bootstrap interval excludes 0 on the positive side

herb_or_termite_reanalysis.reason: new response families require a separate pre-response protocol

claim_boundary.allowed: within-plot habitat-island topology association with tree species richness after area and mound height controls
not_allowed: independent replication of the frozen Structural C-R3 claim
post-hoc rescue of GIFT or AVONET results

forbidden_after_workbook_access: drop area or height control after seeing outcome
change plot qualification using response direction
change H1 sign or bootstrap settings
use herbs or termites to rescue H1
